claims: Backup creation writes the database snapshot, referenced assets, platform state and manifest into a private same-parent staging directory.
A successful backup is promoted with a same-parent rename only after every referenced asset and manifest digest has been written.
A source or copy failure closes the SQLite source handle, removes the staging directory and leaves the final destination absent.
If the final destination appears during creation, promotion fails closed and removes only the staging directory created by that call.
limitations: This is a local single-filesystem atomic-promotion claim; it does not establish off-host retention, staging backup operation, signing, deployment, production rollback or activation.
The final destination remains immutable once present; retention rotation and cleanup require a separately reviewed operator procedure.
